about: The answers of a repository that may go into the core of a family of products, and where each starts: `locked`, kept as it is by every repository of the family, or `default`, where a new repository starts and may change. Each is a decision of the ledger by its id (references/standard-decisions.json gives its question). `blueprint` names the choice of the blueprint the answer is, where the guide asked it; `value` says where the value is read when the ledger row alone does not say it: `tokens` the source colour of design/tokens.json, `screen-sizes` the widths of design/screen-sizes.json. Every other answer's value is what its row says (`source`). `behaviour` gives the rows that are behaviour rules: every row of that layer that is not listed here. `outside` names what never goes into the core. These are only the starting sets: the person answering the lock-or-default sheet moves any answer from one to the other, or leaves it out.
